global_rules.reply_to_policy: All emails in this pack set reply-to support@relopass.com. Replies must never route to the employee, HR user, or supplier directly.
global_rules.escaping_rule: every variable is HTML-escaped by the backend; templates must not rely on raw HTML inside variables

templates.trigger: RFQ is dispatched and a unique magic link is minted for this supplier.
templates.subject: Quote request: {{move_from}} to {{move_to}}
templates.preheader: No account needed. Review the brief and submit your quote by {{respond_by}}.
templates.body_html:
ReloPass

Quote request

Reference: {{rfq_ref}}

Respond by: {{respond_by}}

Hello {{supplier_name}},

ReloPass is a relocation platform used by companies to manage employee moves. A company on our platform is requesting a quote for: {{service_labels}}.

Move brief

{{brief_rows_table}}

What we need from you

1. Confirm that you cover this route and are available around the target move date.

2. Provide your total price. An itemised breakdown is helpful but not required.

3. State how long your quote will remain valid.

4. Flag anything missing or unclear in the brief so we can follow up.

No account is needed. Your link is private and expires in {{link_expires_days}} days. One submission is allowed per link.

Submit your quote

After you submit, the company will review all received quotes and be in touch if they decide to proceed.

Transactional email from ReloPass. Questions? {{support_email}}
templates.rationale: The primary outreach that orients an unfamiliar supplier to the platform, presents the full move brief, and gives clear instructions for submitting a compliant quote.

templates.trigger: Two days before respond_by and the supplier has not yet submitted a quote for this RFQ.
do_not_send_when: supplier has already submitted a quote for this RFQ
the RFQ has been closed or withdrawn
templates.subject: Quote due in {{reminder_days_left}} days: {{rfq_ref}}
templates.preheader: Your unique link is still open. Submit before {{respond_by}} to be considered.
templates.body_html:
ReloPass

Reminder: quote due in {{reminder_days_left}} days

Reference: {{rfq_ref}}

Hello {{supplier_name}},

A quote request is still open and waiting for your response.

Route{{move_from}} to {{move_to}}
Respond by{{respond_by}}
Days remaining{{reminder_days_left}}

Your link is private and expires in {{link_expires_days}} days. One submission is allowed per link.

Submit your quote

If you cannot quote for this request, no action is needed. The request will close automatically after the deadline.

Transactional email from ReloPass. Questions? {{support_email}}
templates.rationale: A single, polite nudge sent two days before the deadline reduces no-response rates without becoming spam.

templates.trigger: Supplier successfully submits a quote via their magic link.
templates.subject: Quote received: {{rfq_ref}}
templates.preheader: Your quote has been logged. The company will review it and be in touch if they proceed.
templates.body_html:
ReloPass

Quote received

What we received

Total{{quote_total}} {{quote_currency}}
Valid until{{quote_valid_until}}

templates.trigger: HR validates this supplier's quote, closing the RFQ.
templates.subject: Your quote has been selected: {{rfq_ref}}
templates.preheader: The company has selected your quote and will be in touch to discuss next steps.
templates.body_text:
Hello {{supplier_name}},

The company has selected your quote for reference {{rfq_ref}}.

A representative from the company will contact you directly to discuss how to proceed. We do not have a timeline for their outreach, but they have been notified.

If you have not heard from them within a reasonable time, contact us at {{support_email}} and we will assist.

Thank you for responding through ReloPass.

ReloPass

Reference: {{rfq_ref}}

do_not_send_when: hr_quotes_ready has already been sent for this RFQ
zero quotes have been received and respond_by has not yet passed

sequence_diagram_text:
RFQ Created
  T+0  supplier_rfq_invite       -> each supplier (immediately on dispatch)
  T+0  employee_rfq_sent         -> employee (immediately on dispatch)

  [Supplier submits a quote]
       supplier_quote_received_ack -> that supplier (immediately)
       employee_quote_received     -> employee (immediately)

  [Employee proposes a preferred quote (any time before respond_by passes)]
       hr_quotes_ready            -> HR (immediately, if not already sent for this RFQ)

  [All recipients have responded (before respond_by)]
       hr_quotes_ready            -> HR (immediately, if not already sent for this RFQ)

  T-2 days before respond_by
       supplier_rfq_reminder      -> each supplier that has not yet submitted (if RFQ still open)

  respond_by passes
    If >= 1 quote received and hr_quotes_ready not yet sent:
       hr_quotes_ready            -> HR (immediately)
    If 0 quotes received:
       hr_rfq_no_response         -> HR (immediately)

  [HR validates one quote]
       supplier_quote_selected    -> the winning supplier (immediately)
       supplier_rfq_closed        -> all other invited suppliers (immediately)
       employee_quote_validated   -> employee (immediately)
       RFQ is now closed.
